definitions.gloss: developing new business; new market development; finding new customers
definitions.explanation: The activity of finding and developing new customers, markets, or business opportunities. A key concept in sales and business strategy.

examples.japanese: {新規|しんき}{開拓|かいたく}に{力|ちから}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: To focus on developing new business.

examples.japanese: {営業|えいぎょう}{部|ぶ}は{新規|しんき}{顧客|こきゃく}の{開拓|かいたく}を{進|すす}めている。
examples.english: The sales department is working on developing new customers.

examples.japanese: {既存|きぞん}{顧客|こきゃく}の{維持|いじ}と{新規|しんき}{開拓|かいたく}のバランスが{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: The balance between maintaining existing customers and developing new ones is important.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard business term, especially in sales and marketing. Can refer to developing new customers, new markets, or new business areas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新規|しんき}{顧客|こきゃく}{開拓|かいたく} (new customer development)
- {新規|しんき}{市場|しじょう}{開拓|かいたく} (new market development)
- {新規|しんき}{開拓|かいたく}{営業|えいぎょう} (new business development sales)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}: new business/venture — refers to starting an entirely new business line rather than finding new customers
